name: ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES_NUMTYPE
description: The Auth Entities Number Type table contains information that describes, for a specific entity in the Auth Entities table, the type (e.g. Phone or Fax) of contact number in the matching related line.

columns.name: AUTH_BUNDLE_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the auth bundle record.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number of the associated entity in the auth bundle. Together with AUTH_BUNDLE_ID, this forms the foreign key to the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple entity contact number types associated with the auth bundle and the auth entitty from the ATB_AUTH_ENTITIES table.

columns.name: ENTITY_CNTCT_TYPE_C_NAME
columns.description: The Entity Contact Type category ID for the Auth Bundle entity.
